I’m not aware of any specific “new” reranker that was added in that release.  
In **llama‑index‑core 0.14.25** the change was to give the *base Reranker class* native async support, so all of the existing reranker implementations (e.g., the embedding‑based ones) can now be used asynchronously out of the box.
